_comment: Slimefoot, the Stowaway CAST THIS TURN, its {4} Saproling, and Utopia Mycon sacrificing that Saproling -> Slimefoot's death trigger deals the last point (opponent at 1). 7 lands = Slimefoot (3) + {4}. The Slimefoot cast opens breakpoint site 9; its continuation [{4} token, sac it] needs the outlet's TRAILING same-line form (MTG_SAC_FODDER_ACT_MAKER): before it the sac outlet was never emitted (no Saproling on the board when the continuation was enumerated) and the line was inexpressible at any budget -- the win slipped to T6 (Slimefoot attacks). Mycon is summoning-sick on purpose: its sac ability has no {T}, so sickness must not matter. Twin: fungusb_slimefoot_onboard_token_sac_ping.
